title: Equality of opposite quadrant probabilities
statement: Let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $(X,Y)$ have the probability distribution obtained from independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ by setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$. The probability that $X\leq0$ and $Y\leq0$ equals the probability that $X>0$ and $Y>0$.
